If you call this function on a server that doesn't use PowerDNS, you will receive an error. * After you enable DNSSEC on the domain, you **must** add the Delegation of Signing (DS) records on your DNS server and with your registrar. * You **cannot** modify the DNSSEC security key. Omission retains active=1, algo_num=8, key_setup=classic, nsec3_iterations=7, nsec3_narrow=1, nsec3_opt_out=0 and use_nsec3=1; no salt default is specified. Selecting algorithm 13 alone does not change the classic default. nsec3_salt is a hexadecimal string. Narrow=1 means Narrow mode and 0 Inclusive mode; opt_out=1 creates records for all delegations and 0 only secure delegations. use_nsec3 selects NSEC3 (1) or NSEC (0); the pinned prose says the system ignores the other NSEC3 options when this value is used. Inspect each domain enabled/nsec_error result separately from WHM metadata; new_key_id remains the pinned string.
